svg.desc: Terminal capture. Scrubbing applied: ports (dev server ports pinned to 3000); hostnames (LAN addresses replaced with a fixed private address); paths (home directory and temporary paths collapsed); qr (QR code re-rendered for the scrubbed network URL)
